newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Tenaga in fibre optic network deal.
newsitem.headline: Tenaga in fibre optic network deal.

text.p: Malaysia's national power utility, Tenaga Nasional Bhd, on Friday signed two agreements with one of its joint ventures for setting up and maintaining of a fibre optic communications network in the country.

Tenaga signed the agreements with Fibre Communication Network (M) Sdn Bhd (Fibrecomm), a joint venture between Tenaga, Celcom, a unit of Technology Resources Industries Bhd, and Malaysian Resources Corporation Bhd.

Fibrecomm said in a statement that the agreements allow it to lease Tenaga's 1,300 km of existing fibre optic lines and lay another 6,500 km of cables along the power company's transmission facilities.
The joint venture company also appointed Tenaga as the maintenance contractor for the network.
Fibrecomm said it will invest 167 million ringgit to complete the project by the second quarter of 1998.
